rows.grounds: fused form: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulam (root Kaula); internal sandhi noted, kept as one token

items.question: Is the attainment of the eight siddhis identified as the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight siddhis are named as attainments.
Attainment of these siddhis is equated with the root Kaula.
The goddess is addressed as fair-faced.
items.inference: Therefore, obtaining the eight siddhis constitutes the essential realization of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact list of the eight siddhis is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula.
